# Pharmaceuticals

This folder catalogs the primary pharmaceutical products used for anticoagulation therapy in Danish atrial fibrillation patients, as monitored by the national AFDK registry. It contains detailed profiles on Direct Oral Anticoagulants (DOACs) and the traditional vitamin K antagonist Marevan (warfarin). Each page synthesizes pharmacovigilance data, comparing the incidence of severe bleeding and ischemic strokes between the two treatment classes, alongside the clinical quality indicators used to ensure safe prescribing and routine monitoring.

## Pages

- [[doac|DOAC]] — Direct Oral Anticoagulants used as a modern alternative for atrial fibrillation, with tracked metrics on renal monitoring and bleeding risks.
- [[marevan]] — The classic oral anticoagulant warfarin, evaluated against DOACs for comparative safety, efficacy, and adverse event incidence.
